subject: public API
fact: apps/tui may import only names in picciuli.__all__ and picciuli.money (no picciuli._*, services internals or sqlalchemy); enforced by apps/tui/tests/test_public_api.py.
reason: Clients must stay on the library's semver-covered public API per docs/development.md. Remembering the enforced rule prevents future TUI changes from importing private helpers (e.g. default_period_name) and failing the boundary test.

subject: TUI testing
fact: apps/tui UI tests drive Textual via run_app() in apps/tui/tests/conftest.py (asyncio.run + App.run_test, fixed TODAY); no pytest-asyncio plugin is used.
reason: Future changes to the console UI need tests in the same style. Knowing that Pilot scenarios run through a sync helper with a fixed clock (and that pytest-asyncio is deliberately absent, with filterwarnings=error) avoids adding plugins or flaky date-dependent tests.

subject: testing layout
fact: API tests live in package apps/api/api_tests (not tests/) so conftest/test module names don't clash with apps/tui/tests under mypy and pytest; import helpers from api_tests.helpers.
reason: mypy reports "Duplicate module named conftest" when two rootless tests dirs have conftest.py, and pytest rejects duplicate test basenames. Future API tests must go in the api_tests package and import shared fakes from api_tests.helpers, otherwise lint/type-check breaks.
